item.diagram_kind: E₂-page table and transgression for the complex Hopf fibration
item.selection_reason: The example records the Hopf fibration S¹→S^{2n+1}→CPⁿ and d₂(u)=x, with H*(CPⁿ)=Z[x]/(x^{n+1}); a compact E₂-page picture can display the only differential.
item.concrete_diagram_content_or_checks: Show E₂^{p,q}=H^p(CPⁿ;H^q(S¹;Z)), with q=0,1 and p=0,2,…,2n; the only possible nonzero differential is d₂:E₂^{p,1}→E₂^{p+2,0}, generated by d₂(u)=x. Check endpoint/truncation at x^{n+1}, convergence to H*(S^{2n+1}), and the chosen sign convention for x.
